basis: docs https://www.riseupgames.com/proshot/android (official Android Guide) + Google Play listing (updated May 13, 2026; What's new) + https://www.riseupgames.com/proshot feature list, as of 2026-10-20. Developer: Rise Up Games (Play listing). Features the official site marks iOS-only (ProRAW, Portrait mode, Live Photo, Monochrome mode, configurable MAX ISO/MAX shutter, compass and altimeter) are excluded.

features.name: Tap focus/exposure point
features.what: Tap the viewfinder to set the focus and exposure point; drag the box to move it; tap the box to reset
features.match_note: touch on the preview sets focus and metering area (FocusImageHandler); no census entry; separate metering area marker

features.name: One-finger zoom
features.what: Drag one finger up or down on the viewfinder to zoom (up to 10X)
features.match_note: zoom only through the manual-strip slider; no gesture zoom on the preview

features.name: Zoom / EV readouts
features.what: Current zoom and exposure compensation values shown at the top of the viewfinder; tap a label to reset its value
features.match_note: current values shown on the manual strips; no tap-to-reset readout

features.name: AE button (AE-L / spot metering)
features.what: Switches metering between center-weighted, AE lock and spot; the spot AE box can be dragged anywhere
features.match_note: with column:EXPOSURE_LOCK; Camera2

features.name: Lens selector
features.what: Switches between the device's available rear lenses (multi-camera devices)
features.match_note: also setting:PHYSICAL_CAMERA_ID

features.name: X-Mode (Vendor Extensions)
features.what: Opens manufacturer modes Beauty, Bokeh, HDR or Night where supported (no manual control, zoom or RAW in these modes)
features.match_note: only Camera1 vendor HDR / True Portrait; no Camera2 extension modes (Night, Bokeh, Beauty)

features.name: Image / Video Format button
features.what: Chooses RAW or JPEG (RAW+JPEG per Play listing) for photos and H.264 or H.265 for video in the current drive mode
features.match_note: codec via the video profile editor

features.name: HEIC
features.what: Saves photos as HEIC on compatible devices
features.match_note: no HEIC/HEIF output

features.name: Preview Image
features.what: Thumbnail of the most recent photo or video in the top bar; opens it

features.name: Grid Overlay
features.what: Toggles between grid options (4 options)

features.name: Aspect Ratio
features.what: Chooses 4:3, 16:9, 1:1 or C (custom ratio such as 21:9 or 5:4; press and hold C to edit) in Photo mode
features.match_note: aspect only by picking a sensor size; no 1:1 or custom crop ratios

features.name: Settings button
features.what: Opens the Settings Panel

features.name: Flash
features.what: Flash menu in the bottom-bar control row

features.name: Video light
features.what: Turns on the flash LED as a continuous light while filming
features.match_note: torch value

features.name: White Balance
features.what: White balance menu (auto or manual)
features.match_note: auto presets via setting:WHITE_BALANCE_MODE

features.name: ISO
features.what: Manual or auto ISO menu

features.name: Shutter Speed
features.what: Manual or auto shutter speed menu

features.name: Focus
features.what: Focus menu with manual focus

features.name: Manual focus assist
features.what: Helps judge sharpness while focusing manually

features.name: PEAK (Focus Peaking)
features.what: Highlights in-focus edges; modes Off, On, Peak MF (only with manual focus), Peak MF-A (only while focus is changing); colour customizable
features.match_note: on/off and colour only; no MF-only or while-focusing modes; needs Preview PostProcessing

features.name: Exposure compensation slider
features.what: Brightness (EV) slider at the bottom of the screen

features.name: Storage remaining indicator
features.what: Shows remaining storage space
features.match_note: info overlay on the camera screen (InfoOverlayModelView); no census entry shows free storage

features.name: Battery meter
features.what: Shows battery level on the camera screen
features.match_note: info overlay on the camera screen (InfoOverlayModelView); no census entry shows battery level

features.name: Front / rear camera toggle
features.what: Switches between rear and selfie camera; selfie camera keeps full manual control

features.name: Shutter button
features.what: Takes the photo or starts the capture of the current drive mode

features.name: Video record shortcut
features.what: Starts video recording instantly from any mode
features.match_note: must switch to the video module first

features.name: Camera Dial
features.what: DSLR-style mode dial switching Auto, Program, Manual, C1, C2
features.match_note: each manual control is auto or set individually; no mode dial and no custom presets

features.name: Drive Dial
features.what: Dial switching Photo, Video, Slo-mo, Light Painting, Time-lapse
features.match_note: photo/video/interval/bracketing modules; slo-mo only as a video profile, no light-painting mode

features.name: Auto
features.what: Fully automatic exposure, no configuration needed
features.match_note: starts in auto exposure

features.name: Program
features.what: Semi-auto: user sets ISO and white balance, app sets shutter speed
features.match_note: ISO priority possible with GlassCam AE on (forced ISO); no named Program mode

features.name: Manual
features.what: User sets ISO and shutter speed
features.match_note: with strip:M_MANUAL_ISO

features.name: Shutter priority / ISO priority
features.what: Fix shutter or ISO and let the app set the other
features.match_note: GlassCam AE keeps a forced shutter or ISO and solves the other, but only after enabling it in settings (Camera2)

features.name: Custom C1 / C2
features.what: Two custom modes that auto-save and recall EV, WB, ISO, shutter and focus
features.match_note: no saved custom setting presets to recall

features.name: Resume Settings
features.what: Off / Auto (keep 10 minutes) / On: whether camera mode and settings are kept after leaving the app
features.match_note: settings and last camera/module always persist; no Off/Auto/On choice

features.name: Dynamic mode switching
features.what: Setting a shutter speed in Auto switches to Manual; setting it back to auto returns to Auto
features.match_note: setting a manual value takes that control out of auto, but no visible mode change

features.name: Photo
features.what: Still-photo drive mode

features.name: EV bracketing
features.what: Zero-lag exposure bracketing up to +/-3 EV (Photo menu)
features.match_note: sequential bracket; zero-lag not claimed

features.name: ENHANCE (Auto Enhance)
features.what: Hardware post-processing for colour and dynamic range; may enable automatic HDR (Photo menu)
features.match_note: processing set per stage (NR, edge, tonemap, lens shade); no one-switch enhance; auto HDR only Camera1

features.name: Timer
features.what: Self-timer before capture

features.name: Video
features.what: Video drive mode with full manual control; size, frame rate, bitrate, mic options, EIS

features.name: Video resolution up to 8K
features.what: Video size up to 8K and 'beyond 4K' on compatible devices, extreme bitrate options
features.match_note: custom resolution/bitrate in the profile editor, device-limited

features.name: Frame rate 24-240 FPS
features.what: Adjustable video frame rate from 24 to 240 FPS
features.match_note: high-speed profiles exist

features.name: EIS
features.what: Electronic image stabilization for video

features.name: LOG / FLAT colour profiles
features.what: Flat video colour profiles for more dynamic range in grading
features.match_note: a flat curve can be drawn by hand; no ready LOG/flat video profile

features.name: 180 degree rule
features.what: Options that tie shutter speed to frame rate (180-degree shutter)
features.match_note: shutter set by hand; not tied to frame rate

features.name: Mic options / Audio Routing
features.what: Choose microphone source, including external mic; 'External' option forces external mic
features.match_note: picks MediaRecorder sources; no forced external-mic routing

features.name: Audio level monitoring
features.what: Shows audio levels in real time while recording
features.match_note: no audio level meter

features.name: Video file size display
features.what: Shows the recording's file size in real time
features.match_note: info overlay on the camera screen (InfoOverlayModelView); no census entry shows storage left / estimated time, not live file size

features.name: Pause / resume recording
features.what: Pause and resume a video recording into one file
features.match_note: no pause/resume while recording

features.name: Simultaneous audio playback
features.what: Other apps' audio (e.g. Spotify) keeps playing while recording
features.match_note: not implemented (no audio-focus handling found)

features.name: Slo-mo
features.what: High frame rate (up to 240 FPS) drive mode with video options
features.match_note: slow-motion only as a high-speed video profile; no dedicated mode

features.name: Light Painting: Light
features.what: Captures light trails
features.match_note: only a single manual long exposure; DNG stack has no lighten-blend trails

features.name: Light Painting: Water
features.what: Smooth flowing water, even in daylight without an ND filter
features.match_note: burst DNGs can be merged after capture by hand; no live long-exposure simulation

features.name: Light Painting: Stars
features.what: Captures star trails at night
features.match_note: no star-trail accumulation

features.name: Light Painting: Bulb
features.what: Simulated bulb (open-ended long exposure)
features.match_note: limited to the sensor's maximum exposure; no open-ended bulb

features.name: Timelapse
features.what: Set duration and interval (from 0.5 s); save frames individually (intervalometer) or as a movie up to 4K
features.match_note: timelapse video via setting:TIMELAPSE_FRAMES

features.name: Storage Location
features.what: Choose a custom save folder

features.name: SHARP
features.what: Toggles sharpening
features.match_note: Camera2

features.name: Screen Brightness
features.what: Sets the screen brightness inside the app
features.match_note: no screen-brightness control

features.name: LEVEL (Horizon Level)
features.what: On-screen horizon level (3 options)

features.name: Histogram
features.what: Live histogram overlay (3 modes)
features.match_note: needs Preview PostProcessing

features.name: OIS
features.what: Toggles optical image stabilization

features.name: NR (Noise Reduction)
features.what: Sets noise reduction / its quality

features.name: Tag with GPS
features.what: Adds location to captures

features.name: Rotation Lock
features.what: Locks the UI orientation
features.match_note: always landscape-locked; no toggle

features.name: Hacks
features.what: Workarounds for devices that hide WB/ISO/shutter/manual focus or RAW from third-party apps
features.match_note: API choice, vendor keys, legacy mode, Bayer/orientation fixes

features.name: Theme
features.what: Changes the UI theme
features.match_note: no light/dark or colour theme choice (only the red night overlay)

features.name: Accent color
features.what: Customizable UI accent colour (panel not named in the sources)
features.match_note: no accent colour choice

features.name: JPEG quality
features.what: Sets JPEG compression quality (panel not named in the sources)

features.name: Lens Mode
features.what: Chooses how lenses in a camera group are selected while zooming
features.match_note: pin one lens or let the phone switch (Camera2)

features.name: Mute shutter sound
features.what: Turns off the shutter sound

features.name: Startup mode
features.what: Chooses the mode the app opens in
features.match_note: reopens in the last-used module (SettingsManager.GetCurrentModule); no fixed startup mode

features.name: Remap volume buttons
features.what: Assigns the volume buttons to an action, including zoom
features.match_note: volume keys step the active manual control; only the camera key / headset hook fire the shutter (KeyPressedController, no census entry); mapping not configurable

features.name: Filename format
features.what: Customizable file names for captures
features.match_note: file names are fixed

features.name: Shortcuts (GPS, screen brightness, camera shutter)
features.what: Quick shortcuts for GPS, screen brightness, shutter and more (exact location not stated)
features.match_note: no shortcuts

features.name: Gimbal zoom support
features.what: Zoom can be driven from a gimbal's controls
features.match_note: no gimbal support

features.name: Camera roll
features.what: Built-in review of photos and videos, reached from the viewfinder, with video playback
